ModMetadata.Name: StationeersLua [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: zedle
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]StationeersLua[/h1] [i]Lua scripting support for Stationeers programmable chips[/i]
Write automation in [b]Lua 5.2[/b] instead of IC10 — tables, functions, coroutines. Server-authoritative multiplayer.
[url=https://discord.gg/HxvySSu5G3][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Orbital%20Foundry-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white[/img][/url] [url=https://ko-fi.com/G2G61S5ZB5][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Support-Ko--fi-FF5E5B?logo=ko-fi&logoColor=white[/img][/url]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]v0.9 highlights[/h2] [list] [*] Built-in Lua language server path for the IC editor: completions, hover, diagnostics, symbols, and formatting tuned for StationeersLua (optional external Lua language server in mod settings for full generic Lua coverage). [*] Richer ic.host_info() for wearables and the ScriptedScreens programmable visor; clearer housing and logic fault messages with better source anchoring. [*] IC10-style housing LED feedback for memory and stack operations. [*] Safer runtime under load: cross-thread tick vs frame timing fixes, picky logic reads and batch writes less likely to halt a chip, Lua formatter guarded so IC10 chips are not corrupted if formatting ever targets one, and richer inner-exception detail in logs when C# throws behind Lua. [/list]
[h2]Editor, reference, and optional MCP[/h2] Searchable [b]in-game Lua reference[/b] when Lua formatting is active, [b]Lua auto-indent[/b] in IC10Editor, sleep/yield inside tick() plus user coroutines, find/find_all with optional glob/regex modes, and Lua in [b]pipe device hosts[/b] and suit housings. Optional in-game [b]MCP[/b] and REST (off by default) pair with the [b]StationeersLua VS Code extension[/b] when you enable [b]Enabled[/b] / [b]EnableExtensionApi[/b]; [b]EnableExperimentalDebugger[/b] unlocks the VS Code debug adapter. Multiplayer can use an optional [b]debug proxy[/b] on private servers.
[h2]Wireless suit and tablets[/h2] [b]Wireless Development Board[/b] EVA suit module: pick powered omni networks, mesh handoff, reconnect grace, small extra suit drain while linked ([b]Allow network chip access[/b] must be on). [b]Lua chips in suit IC slots[/b] on that suit share the board wireless data network (ic.net, batch, require). [b]Lua chips in the Sanitation Survival Toolbelt[/b] on the same player share that network too. ic.wireless from suit chips, belt chips, or [b]ScriptedScreens wireless cartridges[/b] lists, connects, or disconnects the omni link in Lua.
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] [*] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3592775931]IC10Editor[/url] (Steam) — recommended [/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Lua chip & sandbox[/h2] [b]Integrated Circuit (Lua)[/b] in any IC housing. Default instruction limits: [b]500,000[/b] init, [b]50,000[/b]/tick (server/host can change [b]Lua VM[/b] mod config). No arbitrary filesystem or process access. Standard libraries: math, string, table, coroutine, utf8, pcall/xpcall, JSON, optional HTTP. UTF-8 Unicode in source through editor, save, and network.
[h2]Devices & memory[/h2] [list] [*] Read/write logic, slots, reagents, device memory by pin or ReferenceId; batch read/write across all devices of a type (Average, Sum, Min, Max) [*] Label devices, device_list, prefab/name hashes, 512-word chip memory, IC10-compatible stack, 53-bit bitwise ops [/list]
[h2]Inter-chip networking[/h2] On the same data cable network: direct send/receive, broadcast, pub/sub with wildcards + retained messages + TTL, RPC with timeouts, MessagePack pack/unpack.
[h2]Library chips & persistence[/h2] [b]Library chips[/b] (--@module name) expose require("name") to other chips on the network (compiled into the caller). Auto-save source + registers/stack/memory; optional serialize/deserialize for custom state blobs.
[h2]Events[/h2] ic.events.on / off for custom events (e.g. ScriptedScreens UI) dispatched at the start of each tick.
[h2]In-game debugger[/h2] [b]Motherboard (Lua Debugger)[/b] on the data network inspects live Lua chips: errors, tracebacks, memory, logs, and quick editor access.
[h2]IC10 editor integration[/h2] Lua syntax highlighting; open the [b]?[/b] panel to disable script/line caps for long scripts.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🚀 Quick start[/h2] [olist] [*] Install BepInEx, LaunchPad, IC10Editor; subscribe here [*] Craft [b]Integrated Circuit (Lua)[/b], insert in IC housing, open editor, paste: [/olist] [b]Quick sample:[/b] a short while-loop toggles pin [b]d0[/b] every second using logic enums and sleep(1). A paste-ready listing ships in [b]GUIDE.MD[/b].
[hr][/hr]
[h2]IC10 → Lua[/h2] [table][tr][th]IC10[/th][th]Lua[/th][/tr] [tr][td]l r0 d0 Temperature[/td][td]read(0, LT.Temperature)[/td][/tr] [tr][td]s d0 On 1[/td][td]write(0, LT.On, 1)[/td][/tr] [tr][td]lb r0 HASH("GasSensor") Temperature 2[/td][td]batch_read(hash("GasSensor"), LT.Temperature, LBM.Average)[/td][/tr] [tr][td]sleep 5[/td][td]sleep(5)[/td][/tr] [tr][td]push 42 / pop r0[/td][td]stack_push(42) / stack_pop()[/td][/tr] [/table] Locals, tables, and functions replace register gymnastics.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]ScriptedScreens[/h2] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3666779631][b]ScriptedScreens[/b][/url] — Lua-driven touch UIs on consoles/tablets; requires StationeersLua.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Documentation[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://orbitalfoundrymodteam.github.io/StationeersLuaDocs/]📖 Online documentation[/url] — full API + guides [*] [b]GUIDE.MD[/b] (beginner walkthrough) and [b]MAPPING.MD[/b] (IC10 line-by-line) ship with the mod [/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]VS Code extension (separate install)[/h2] Install the [b]StationeersLua[/b] VS Code extension (pair with [b]EnableExtensionApi[/b]): Chip Explorer groups chips by data network, explicit [b]Export[/b] compiles to the chip, metadata-only auto refresh, conflict-aware pulls using per-chip [b]source_version[/b], and debug actions when [b]EnableExperimentalDebugger[/b] is on in the game.
[h2]Reference panel + ScriptedScreens[/h2] With [b]ScriptedScreens[/b] installed, its embedded API reference merges into the same in-game Lua help panel opened from the IC editor.
[h2]Dedicated servers & HTTP[/h2] Dedicated hosts do not publish the MCP HTTP listener; keep AI/REST tools on player clients. Wireless + laptop flows can still merge remote network chips into the motherboard dropdown when the suit board is connected.
[h2]Upgrading[/h2] First load after a big update on an older world may skip restoring some serialized event or serialize data until you [b]save once and reload[/b]. Full MCP/REST tables: [b]GUIDE.MD[/b]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Troubleshooting[/h2] [list] [*] [b]Script idle?[/b] Use a Lua IC (not IC10), power the housing, switch on [*] [b]Syntax?[/b] ~= for not-equal; and/or/not [*] [b]Missing device?[/b] d0–d5 → indices 0–5 (Adv. racks extend range); device_list() / print(device_id(0)) [*] [b]Stuttering?[/b] Stay inside per-tick instruction budget; sleep/yield in tight loops [/list]
[hr][/hr]
